title: Chapter 1 Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of Unreal Engine basics, installation, editor navigation, and project management!

questions.question: What is Unreal Engine?
questions.explanation: Unreal Engine is a real‑time 3D creation tool used for games, film, architecture, and more.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a use case for Unreal Engine?
questions.explanation: Unreal Engine is not designed for spreadsheet work; it's for real‑time 3D applications.

questions.question: Unreal Engine is open source, with full C++ source code available.
questions.explanation: The engine's C++ source is publicly available on GitHub, allowing deep customization.

questions.question: What is the name of the Epic Games application used to install Unreal Engine?
questions.explanation: The Epic Games Launcher is the hub for downloading Unreal Engine and managing versions.

questions.question: What does a version number like '5.4.2' represent?
questions.explanation: Unreal uses Major.Minor.Patch, e.g., 5 (major), 4 (minor), 2 (patch).

questions.question: You must uninstall an old version of Unreal Engine before installing a new one.
questions.explanation: Multiple versions can be installed side‑by‑side via the Epic Games Launcher.

questions.question: How much free disk space is roughly needed for a standard Unreal Engine installation?
questions.explanation: A typical UE5 installation requires about 40 GB of free space.

questions.question: Which project template should you choose to start with an empty level and no pre‑made logic?
questions.explanation: The Blank template provides a completely empty world, ideal for learning from scratch.

questions.question: Why should you enable 'Starter Content' when creating a new project?
options: It provides free basic materials and props
questions.explanation: Starter Content includes essential materials, shapes, and props that accelerate learning.

questions.question: The panel that lists all actors currently in your level is called the __________.
questions.explanation: The World Outliner displays every actor placed in the level.

questions.question: What do you hold to enter 'fly' mode in the viewport?
questions.explanation: Holding the Right Mouse Button activates fly mode, allowing WASD movement.

questions.question: To focus the camera on a selected object, press the _____ key.
questions.explanation: Pressing F while an object is selected instantly focuses the viewport camera on it.

questions.question: How do you save the current level?
questions.explanation: Ctrl + S saves the current level. Save All (Ctrl+Shift+S) saves all modified assets.

questions.question: Saving the level automatically saves all texture and blueprint changes.
questions.explanation: Level files and asset files are independent. Use Save All to save everything.

questions.question: Which project folder contains all your assets like materials, blueprints, and levels?
questions.explanation: The Content folder is the root for all user‑created and imported assets.

questions.question: What does an asterisk (*) next to a file name in the Content Browser indicate?
questions.explanation: An asterisk means the asset has been modified but not saved yet.

questions.question: The World Outliner and Content Browser serve the same purpose.
questions.explanation: World Outliner shows actors placed in the level; Content Browser shows asset files.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Details panel?
options: Edit properties of a selected actor
questions.explanation: The Details panel displays and allows editing of all properties for the currently selected object.

questions.question: Which viewport control allows you to pan the camera without rotating?
questions.explanation: Holding the middle mouse button (scroll wheel click) and dragging pans the view.

questions.question: To fly downward while holding the right mouse button, press the _____ key.
questions.explanation: Q flies down; E flies up.

questions.question: Unreal Engine requires an internet connection to run the editor.
questions.explanation: Once installed, the editor runs offline. Internet is only needed for download and asset store.

questions.question: What is the shortcut to save all currently unsaved assets?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+Shift+S triggers 'Save All', saving every asset with pending changes.
